mission: Law-abiding apps/labs/* lab apps via create-package variants (nextjs, vite, service; tauri phase 2) and a beep delete-package that fully prunes every registration surface.
statusNote: Two tracks, one packet (operator-ratified 2026-08-13): registration geometry + delete-package first, labs scaffolding second, tauri last. Split (phase superseded + sibling packet) if either track grows a second primary. All 14 track decisions are locked in SPEC Decision Log; do not re-litigate them.

provenance.note: Authored directly from the operator objective plus a 6-lane exploration fan-out and a 4-round /grill-with-docs interview on 2026-08-13. No explorations/ packet; DoR content (problem, appetite, no-gos, decision log, first slice, capability check) is carried in SPEC.md and research/.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

phases.name: Census ratification and geometry schema design
Implement apps/labs substrate and v1 variants

stopConditions: A lab variant would require relaxing a code law (schema-first, effect-first, portless wrapping, identity registration, import boundaries) rather than a path-scoped ceremony exemption.
delete-package cannot name a closed, testable set of registration surfaces without a live inventory (the geometry schema must stay the single source of the prune list).
Zero-root-churn proves impossible for a shared surface with no glob/reconstructive mechanism and the fallback would be per-lab hand edits to shared config.
Either track would absorb unrelated create-package, architecture-command, or CI-topology redesign work.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, cost, destructive side effects outside the target lab, or policy approval.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
